input_contract.alphabet: VCF SNV/indel records with genome annotations

score_contract.score_semantics: CADD deleteriousness score, not a sequence-model log-likelihood ratio

provenance.notes: The official CADD v1.7 GRCh38 public API was qualified against all 946 locked records without GPU work. HTTP requests were successful for 946/946 rows; usable CADD raw/PHRED values were returned for 918/946 (97.0402%), while 28 rows remain explicit requested-ref/alt missingness. Evidence: artifacts/phase6a/comparators/cadd_grch38_v1.7_20260921.json and artifacts/phase6a/phase6a_comparator_qualification_20260921.json. The approximately 300 GB offline annotation bundle was not downloaded, and the source's non-commercial availability/legal terms remain a redistribution review item. This is a qualified public comparator role, deliberately SUBSET_ONLY in the model registry so it cannot enter the Evo2-only foundation-model benchmark.
